text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today.
Now, if you will excuse me, I shall head back to the dormitory early.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I must rest my body well to prepare for tomorrow's exhibition race.
You should take it easy too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Thanks, same to you.
Thank you, right back at you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus has been invited to an exhibition race.
It's an offer stemming from her recent success and popularity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's an offer I'm very grateful for, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: So Trainer's on a business trip starting today...
choice_data_list: I can't go back until just before the event race...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it would be difficult to even oversee training in that state.
...Indeed.
choice_data_list: I'm really sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No, it can't be helped. It's part of the job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I will do what I can on my end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And... just as we feared, we weren't able to train up until today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All the time we have left is for final adjustments right before the race. But—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, we'll be arriving shortly.
Once we put our bags down, let us begin."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've finished my stretches.
I'm ready when you are.
choice_data_list: Then, how about a jog—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, around 3 km, right? Given today's distance.
Anticipating that, I've made sure to train for it daily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The words I was just about to say flowed smoothly from Ikuno Dictus's mouth instead.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Also, regarding the training menu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Strangely enough, I knew both what she feared
and what words would follow.
choice_data_list: You've been keeping up with your independent training, right? Then...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, I believe that won't be necessary today.
Now, as for other matters to review...
choice_data_list: Where to make your move in the race, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Judging from your instructions so far,
we're starting from that hill over there... right?
choice_data_list: It's like you read my mind.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, likewise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the exhibition race—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Ikuno Dictus!
With her relentless stride, no one else can keep up!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus reaches the goal!
What a brilliant run to electrify this race!

text_block_list.name: Victory Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, that was a spectacular run just now!

text_block_list.name: Victory Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! Just what kind of preparation did you do
to make a run like that possible...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Preparations, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I exchanged glances with Ikuno Dictus and blinked a few times.
While I appreciated the high evaluation, still...
choice_data_list: ...No, nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...What!?
E-Even after running such a flawless race...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
At all times,
you respond with the optimal solution.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if I am not in peak condition...
Even if there are flaws when I am alone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Brushing past all my hesitation, you supported me unconditionally...
and led me all the way to real results.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Which is why I simply do the best I can in that moment.
choice_data_list: Mutual trust is the secret to victory.
Mutual trust is the secret to victory.
Sometimes I almost forget that I'm a student.
Thank you for believing in me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Which is why I simply do the best I can in that moment.
choice_data_list: Mutual trust is the secret to victory.
Mutual trust is the secret to victory.
Sometimes I almost forget that I'm a student.
Thank you for believing in me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As I said before, it is all because
I have a partner who takes
the appropriate actions.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...If we both feel that way,
then that is truly fortunate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus's gaze was direct and earnest... I resolved to work even harder from now on to strengthen that mutual trust.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I muttered, "My student days weren't anything special..."
Ikuno Dictus pricked up her ears with interest.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ho... Trainer-san's school days, is it?
choice_data_list: Huh, are you interested?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so.
I've always wanted to hear about the path
that led to who you are today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so we chatted about our student days...
It turned into a wonderful opportunity
to get to know each other better.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Right back at you.

text_block_list.name: Victory Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text: ...How should I put it, that's so cool...!
choice_data_list: But it's enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing the satisfied look on Ikuno Dictus's face made me feel that our brief exchange had conveyed everything.
